Title: Generally available: Azure Stream Analytics in one new region

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics is now generally available in one new region:

  • Qatar Central

With this announcement, Stream Analytics is now available in 53 Azure regions worldwide. For more information about local pricing, visit the Azure Stream Analytics pricing webpage.
